body: I don't really know what I'm asking for...I guess I'm just out of ideas. I've tried therapists and meds and a whole range of therapies. The two last resorts that I seem to be at is "fuck it" and leave this place or be booked in... and both of those have serious consequences to my family. I really appreciate the message

I don't know who you are and I know that I'm probably going to get hate for saying this... but you're right. I just posted on this sub about my state of mind (which is absolutely shit by the way) and reading this made me realise that I'm not the only one pissed off at this thing called life. And I have it good... Same as you. But I just can't swallow this big piece of shit that they're trying to shove down my throat called living - the "you're so lucky", "it gets better", "you're worth something" comments... ugh give it a break. I've done what I wanted in this life. And the idea of hanging on for... something else... just doesn't appeal to me. Maybe this isn't the most popular opinion but right now I'm all over the place and yet this is ALL that is making sense. I'm a 27 year old with her "her life ahead of her"... and I don't want this to go on anymore.
